scope: Import durability on persistent write failure, real extracted store/claim/JSON implementation in isolated temp directory
confirmed: Pending import is consumed/deleted before destination write succeeds. With destination path occupied by a directory, load returns 3 qrmenü occurrences in memory but no persistent record or pending import remains; a second load returns 0. Success control persists/reloads 3.
cause: AppGroup.claim removes claimed bytes before decode/merge/save.
PersonalHistoryStore.save ignores JSONFile.write Bool result, so load cannot roll back/requeue.
impact: Imported learning can disappear on reload after a write failure; app imported-word catalog may retain a separate view but is not automatically replayed by this store.
limits: Injected destination-is-directory failure, not proof of a naturally occurring device failure.
Extracted production function bodies with renamed storage namespaces; publishing omitted and lock runs serially, so UI sharing/concurrency are not tested.
No user files or simulator profile touched.
validation: ImportDurabilityAuditTests passed both expected observations; diagnostic passing confirms reproduced defect, not correct product behavior.
next_step: Check ignored write results in app import catalog and TypingHistory flush; separate shared crash-loss family from distinct UI catalog inconsistency.
